messages.subject: exchangeable and besag
parts:
Hello 

In my model ar1 works better rw2 and rw1, and also exachangable better than besag. 
Can you please explain when we prefer ar1 over rw and exchangeable over besag because I assumed that rw and besag should work far better than others in anycondition.

Thanks
Aynaz

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] exchangeable and besag
parts:
There is no ground truth here... RW1 is a limiting form of AR1, and AR1
is stationary, RW1 is not, so you have some arguments just there
